facts.text: I am trying to keep track of my rewards and points.
I have Walgreens Balance Rewards.
I have Target RedCard.
I have Giant Eagle Advantage Card.
I have CVS ExtraCare.
I currently have 10,000 Walgreens Balance Rewards points.
My 10,000 Walgreens Balance Rewards points are equivalent to $10 worth of rewards.
I earn 10 Walgreens Balance Rewards points for every dollar I spend.
I can redeem Walgreens Balance Rewards in increments of 5,000 points for $5 off a purchase.
I recently redeemed 5,000 Walgreens Balance Rewards points to get $5 off my purchase of shampoo and conditioner.
I currently have no cashback rewards with Target RedCard.
I earned $40 cashback last month with Target RedCard when I bought a new TV for $800.
I earn 5% cashback on all Target RedCard purchases.
Target RedCard cashback is automatically applied to my next purchase.
I currently have 200 fuel points.
I can redeem my 200 fuel points for 20 cents off per gallon at the gas station.
I earn fuel points for every dollar I spend on groceries.
I got a $5 welcome offer just for signing up for the fuel points program.
I currently have $2 in CVS ExtraBucks rewards.
I earned my $2 in ExtraBucks rewards from buying sale items like toothpaste and mouthwash.
I earn 2% cashback on all CVS ExtraCare purchases.
I got a $10 rewards coupon in the mail last month for CVS ExtraCare.
I want a plan to maximize my rewards earnings for my next few purchases.
